BUILT FOR THE DRIVE /
How to play
WASD / arrows to drive · Space to drift · Shift for nitro · R to recover · Esc to pause.
Gamepad: left stick steer, RT gas, LT brake, B drift, X nitro, Start pause.
On touch screens hold gas and steering together, then add drift or nitro.
Nitro charges by drifting and over blue pads.
Take the shortcut tunnel or the outer road.
Rain and mud reduce grip, so slow before corners.
Earn coins and upgrade your car in the workshop.
